gate_preregistration.gate3_filter_survival_rule: No entry filter added; survival_rate still must remain >= 5%.
gate_preregistration.gate4_acceptance: Majority-window EV improvement, no EV-regressed windows, survival >= 5%, and controlled drawdown damage.

history_guardrails.why_not_simple_repeat: This uses the broad-rotation state on breakout_long only. The prior broad-rotation experiment tested trend_long and failed because of drawdown/Sharpe damage.

hypothesis: Existing breakout_long candidates may deserve a state-aware risk budget when IWM 20-day momentum leads SPY by more than 2pp, because broad participation can confirm breakout follow-through.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM data limits were bypassed by selecting another alpha branch.

next_retry_requires: Do not retry nearby broad-rotation breakout multipliers on the same threshold if rejected.
A valid retry needs event/news context, candidate replacement value, or a richer breadth discriminator.
If promoted, implement the state field and sizing branch through shared production/backtest policy.

parameters.single_causal_variable: breakout_long risk multiplier when IWM 20d return minus SPY 20d return > 0.02
